changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO ps_m_savings_account (savings_account_id, total_vat_amount_derived, account_name, created_by, created_on_utc, last_modified_by, last_modified_on_utc) SELECT sa.id, 0, COALESCE(c.display_name, g.name, sa.account_no), COALESCE(sa.created_by, 1), COALESCE(sa.created_on_utc, NOW()), COALESCE(sa.last_modified_by, COALESCE(sa.created_by, 1)), COALESCE(sa.last_modified_on_utc, NOW()) FROM m_savings_account sa LEFT JOIN ps_m_savings_account psa ON psa.savings_account_id = sa.id LEFT JOIN m_client c ON c.id = sa.client_id LEFT JOIN m_group g ON g.id = sa.group_id WHERE psa.savings_account_id IS NULL;

UPDATE ps_m_savings_account psa JOIN m_savings_account sa ON sa.id = psa.savings_account_id LEFT JOIN m_client c ON c.id = sa.client_id LEFT JOIN m_group g ON g.id = sa.group_id SET psa.account_name = COALESCE(c.display_name, g.name, sa.account_no), psa.last_modified_on_utc = NOW() WHERE psa.account_name IS NULL OR TRIM(psa.account_name) = '';
